# ReactionsConfig

`jaff.core.reaction.config.ReactionsConfig`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Settings of the reactions (`[network.reactions]`).

Each key applies to every reaction, unless a reaction's own table
(`reaction."<serialized>"`) sets it.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reaction` | `dict[str, ReactionConfig]` | Per-reaction settings keyed by serialized reaction; a key set there wins over the same key here. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`resolve`](resolve.md) | Return the settings of one reaction, every key set. |
